integrity: The claimed formula is proved analytically from the defining expression and Clarkson inequalities. No numerical search, finite enumeration, or external certificate is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for real \(\ell_p(I)\) sequence spaces with at least two coordinates; it does not address general Banach spaces or complex variants.
The proof gives explicit extremizers but does not classify all equality cases.
The literature comparison is strong but cannot exclude an obscure or poorly indexed independent derivation.
title: Exact P-angle constant of real \(\ell_p\) sequence spaces
